video.title: AI欧腐《不朽之腐/Eternal Decay》
video.desc:
前两天就下了 由于我懒没做 今天又有人提 我闲着就翻译下
In a future world, a sudden mass self-destruction by the new humans occurs. Klaus, a lowly primitive soldier, is sent to an island prison to seek help from the imprisoned genius scientist Theodore. The two initially clash in fear and humiliation, but through their investigation, they discover each other's vulnerability and struggles, forging a twisted yet genuine bond. Ultimately, Theodore ends the new human tyranny through self-destruction, leaving a peaceful world for Klaus.
未来世界，新人类突然爆发大规模自毁事件。Klaus，一名地位低微的原始人类士兵，被派往一座孤岛监狱，向被囚禁其中的天才科学家 Theodore 求助。
两人起初在恐惧与羞辱中针锋相对，却在调查过程中逐渐看见了彼此的脆弱与挣扎，结下一段扭曲却真实的羁绊。最终，Theodore 以自毁终结了新人类的暴政，为 Klaus 留下了一个和平的世界。
